title: Microsoft Places: workplace app for hybrid work comes to GCC High
summary: The roadmap details and documented Places controls are supported. The cost rating needs correction: the briefing calls the cost low while describing paid space licences and Copilot licences, which are not indirect costs only. The Places Administrator path and Teams Premium transition wording also need small qualifications.

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A low cost rating represents the briefing's documented space and Copilot licence costs.
claims.quote:
cost: "low"
Cost scale: low = indirect cost only: admin time, communications, training.
Page: rooms need an MTR, MTSS or MTSS-SS licence, and individual desks an MTSS or MTSS-SS licence.
Page: Quick book and Copilot room booking need a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.fix: Set cost to 'medium' and replace its rationale with 'Medium. Core Places features are included in the listed user plans, but individual desk booking, autorelease, occupancy reports and AI features can require additional licences. GCC High entitlement is not yet published.' This keeps the stated mixed licensing and the documented potential direct costs consistent with the assessment scale.
